title: * Stylish 3BR Getaway by LCS Signature Properties
description:
Bright and Modern 3BR Retreat in Gallatin - Easy Drive to Nashville

Welcome to our stylish, centrally located home in Gallatin, TN — just 30 minutes from the vibrant heart of downtown Nashville. Perfectly blending comfort and convenience, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath retreat offers a relaxing escape with modern touches and thoughtful amenities. Whether you're here for a quick getaway or an extended stay, you'll love the proximity to Nashville, local attractions, and outdoor adventures.

The space
Property Highlights:

❣️Just 30 minutes from downtown Nashville
❣️Less than 10 minutes to the Gallatin square
❣️Convenient and central location 

The Home: 

☀️ 3BD/2.5BA - comfortably sleeps 6
☀️ Fully stocked kitchen 
☀️ 2 tastefully designed queen bedrooms
☀️ Kids' bunk room with books/games
☀️ Garage access/overflow parking available
☀️ Friendly, walkable neighborhood 
☀️ Complementary coffee, tea and snacks
☀️ In-unit washer/dryer available 
☀️ Upper balcony with seating for 2

Things to do:

💫  Discover Nashville’s vibrant food scene and iconic music venues 
💫  Enjoy local shopping and dining in Downtown Gallatin and The Streets at Indian Lake 
💫 Explore Old Hickory Lake with options for water activities, hiking, biking, and scenic greenway trails 
💫 Visit Tennessee’s stunning state parks and waterfalls
💫 Have fun with the provided corn hole set and BBQ grill for some outdoor entertainment
💫 Bring your golf clubs and enjoy the local golf course, less than a mile away

Perfect for families, friends, or small groups, this home offers everything you need for a relaxing stay with easy access to the best of Gallatin and Nashville.

Guest access
Entire home is available for guest use, with the exception of the owner’s closets and garage refrigerator
